steps.text: If the player has not completed The Final Dawn:

steps.npc: You do not have an appointment.
You do not have an appointment.
An appointment to see the Queen.
First, because it is my job. Second, because she is not in Fortis at the moment.

steps.player: Oh. Well where is she then?

steps.npc: She has important business elsewhere in the kingdom. Perhaps when she returns, you'll be able to see her, or perhaps you won't.

steps.player: Yes, those generally are the two options.

steps.npc: Now, if there's nothing else, please move along.

steps.text: If the player has completed The Final Dawn:

steps.npc: If you wish to speak with the Queen, please be quick. She is very busy and does not need you taking up too much of her time.
